notes: The source is named only by its title «رجال الكشي» (rule 11); the author of the book is not named in the text, so the chain is written from the text alone.
«[-/6]» is an editor's number, left out; «و غيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter with إبراهيم بن عبد الحميد.
«قالوا: قال أبو عبد الله عليه السلام» — the Imam is the last link as imam_in_text.
